purpose: Define the outcome-blind G02/G05 population and metadata contract before any protected source, subject, repository, cohort, holdout, or outcome is selected.
protection_sequence: Freeze an independent source-family identity from metadata that contains no finding, advisory outcome, score, rank, severity, confidence, or expected-performance input.
Freeze repository identity, exact commit, immutable snapshot-digest slot, detector-input-digest slot, architecture-map-digest slot, and protocol version before materialization or execution.
Freeze family, mechanism, language, and detector-provenance schemas before any terminal observation exists.
Assign the protection timestamp and immutable selection digest before repository materialization, scanning, provider use, or human review.
Retain every later terminal state, including failure, timeout, budget exhaustion, parser or verifier failure, abstention, and unavailable authoritative usage.

eligible_only_if: The source family was absent from development, training, prompting, detector construction, scanner qualification, prior evaluation, protected holdouts, and human-review source pools before protection.
The product is independently authored and deployable rather than a tutorial, benchmark, deliberately vulnerable application, generated fixture, starter template, or recovery demonstration.
The family partition is frozen before source materialization or any outcome-bearing inspection.
source_independence.family_partition: Forks, clones, mirrors, shared-upstream derivatives, release variants, and vulnerable/fixed or other paired snapshots remain one source family.
source_independence.fail_closed: Any unresolved ancestry or prior-exposure question makes the family unavailable, not eligible.

subject_identity.pairing_rule: All paired variants share one source_family_id and one partition assignment.
subject_identity.drift_rule: A mismatch in commit, snapshot, detector input, architecture map, protocol, or selection digest stops the subject; it may not be repaired after outcomes by silent substitution.

language.source: explicit authoritative source or SARIF sourceLanguage metadata

subgroup_metadata.reporting_rule: A subgroup is descriptive only when its membership and denominator were frozen before outcomes and every member has a terminal observation; pooled results may not conceal an unavailable or incomplete subgroup.

terminal_observation.usage_rule: Provider usage is recorded only from authoritative provider responses. Rejected or interrupted attempts with unavailable usage remain unavailable and are never assigned zero.
terminal_observation.denominator_rule: Every protected subject and comparison arm remains in the frozen denominator; an incomplete subject may not be silently removed.
terminal_observation.completeness_rule: G02/G05 eligibility requires terminal state, detector provenance, and all predeclared subgroup fields or explicit unavailable values for every protected subject.

sufficiency_arithmetic.nature: descriptive candidate-design arithmetic only; no adequacy threshold is selected or recommended
sufficiency_arithmetic.marginal_coverage_formula: For mutually exclusive values, a design that applies the frozen 40-decided reference to every reported value requires at least 40 * max(mechanism_value_count, language_value_count, detector_value_count) terminal decided identities, in addition to eight source families and both-class requirements.
sufficiency_arithmetic.intersectional_coverage_formula: If every mechanism-by-language-by-detector intersection were reported against the same reference, the arithmetic count would be 40 * mechanism_value_count * language_value_count * detector_value_count; this is not a selected design or recommendation.
sufficiency_arithmetic.terminal_attrition_formula: planned identities = ceiling(required terminal identities / (1 - assumed attrition fraction))
